transport: JSON-lines stdio: ssgg-desktop --stdio; Unix socket default $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/ssgg-desktop/service.sock; request {id,method,params}; response {id,result} or {id,error:{code,message}}. Replies only, no unsolicited events. Poll state.get.

params.volume: optional number 0..1, base gain not attenuated

params.balance: optional software balance -1..1; positive favors b/chat; physical gains come from physical.sample, never scalar inversion
params.enabled: optional boolean; hardware mode requires an acquired fresh connected sample
params.inputMode: optional software|hardware; never starts hardware acquisition

battery.reason: Source-supported dedicated protocol; local hardware validation pending. Explicit acquisition required

physicalChatmix.reason: Source-supported dedicated protocol; local hardware validation pending. Explicit acquisition required

params.id: exact devices.list id; only dedicated 1038:227e interface3/ffc0:1 supported
params.hardwareEnabled: optional bool: true explicitly acquires and queries status; false cancels/releases. Never persisted or auto-reconnected
params.sidetone: optional integer 0..3, requires opt-in; verified by settings readback
params.autoOffMinutes: optional integer 0..255, requires opt-in; sent only, no supported readback
params.statusRefresh: optional bool: true queues documented status query after opt-in

device.set.result: full state with physical; asynchronous acceptance, inspect physical.pending/error/lastCommand for completion. All parameters validated before enqueue/open; no device settings persisted. Disable cannot be combined with writes.

params.id: exact devices.list id, includes hidraw node generation; only 1038:1642 interface 1 (Apex Pro TKL Gen 3 wired)
params.allowHardware: required literal true; permission for this single Apply, not persisted
params.brightness: required integer 0..100; scales color, zero sends black

lighting.apply.result: {pending:true}: request accepted, NOT completion. Poll devices[].lighting.pending/error/lastSent; lastSent {color:[r,g,b],brightness:N} is populated only after successful feature sends, never readback. Partial send is not success. History is cleared on disconnect/service restart.
lighting.apply.policy: No automatic acquisition, startup/reconnect/profile replay, effects, queries or on-board save. Each Apply uses an independent one-shot worker (HID open/ioctl cannot stall the headset/audio service), opens exactly one matching interface, holds a node-level advisory lock, sends 643-byte 0x4b init then 643-byte 0x40 direct feature reports, closes without destructor writes. Other RGB programs must be closed. USB reconnect restores on-board lighting. Source-derived from OpenRGB 19112cdeff94086fa994c4a9cf45ec5786a599bf, physical RGB validation pending. 1628 experimental implementation/gate is intentionally not used. Safe mode rejects before enumeration/open and cancels any remaining report boundaries of an in-flight request. No blocking join on service shutdown. Headset/audio owners untouched.

physical.location: state.get.result.physical; selected devices entry also has physical
physical.fields: deviceId, hardwareEnabled, hardwareAcquired, connected (wireless tri-state), battery, charging, sample {gamePercent,chatPercent,balance,receivedAtMs}|null, statusAtMs|null, stale, pending, sidetone|null, autoOffMinutesSent|null, lastCommand|null, error|null
physical.policy: Unknown/stale sample is null, never synthetic center. Runtime explicit opt-in only; status heartbeat every 10s, freshness deadline 15s. Wireless offline/unknown, read/query error or stale status stops owner and disarms hardware mixing without restoring gains or rerouting speakers. Reacquire with hardwareEnabled:true then explicitly enable mixer again. hardwareEnabled acquisition alone never enables mixer.

safety: No construction/inventory/config-loading audio or HID mutations. Default mixer disabled and hardware unacquired every process start. User mutation arms session reapply for restarted assigned apps; group wheelSide none and unmanaged excluded from physical attenuation. Config isolated in $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/ssgg-desktop/state.json. No capture/microphone operations. HID queries/settings only after device.set hardwareEnabled:true; --safe-mode refuses acquisition and all audio/HID writes. pactl required at runtime.
notes: IDs are u32 numbers at RPC boundary (not renderer display strings).
state.get keys are mixer/backend, not chatmix/audio.
Stream volume/muted are base intent; effectiveVolume/effectiveMuted report actual Pulse state.
Disconnect clears stale inventory and disarms reapply; user must reactivate after reconnect.
Groups are logical per-app controls, not automatically created null buses.

Device inventory is enumeration only. Only exact 1038:227e interface3/ffc0:1 is supported. Empty serial strings in enumerated IDs are preserved. Multiple Nova control receivers are refused to avoid ambiguous VID/PID driver selection.
--safe-mode denies audio/HID mutation RPC, while settings/profiles.save remain usable.
Unix daemon survives GUI disconnect; --stdio ends at stdin EOF. No automatic gain restoration on exit; saved per-stream gain tracking prevents compounding on service restart.
Bounded: 64 KiB input line; 16 pending RPCs; 8 socket clients; 1s queue expiry; 3s per pactl command; 8s aggregate cycle; 4MiB command output; 30s socket idle timeout.
pactl executable resolved by SSGG_PACTL or PATH; desktop has no compile-time Pulse dependency and adds no dependencies.

HID owner uses 50ms passive reads, bounded 1s queries, 8 queued settings batches, latest-state mailbox rather than an unbounded event queue. Audio worker ticks every 200ms independent of GUI polling; backend operation time can increase latency. Cancel is nonblocking; pending batches are dropped, an already-running bounded query can finish. Shutdown joins and releases owner.

Settings validation is atomic before acquisition/enqueue, not a transactional HID write: a later failure cannot roll back prior commands. physical.sidetone is verified readback; autoOffMinutesSent means write success only. physical.lastCommand is queued|completed|failed; physical.pending reports outstanding acquisition/settings.

devices[].connected describes receiver enumeration, physical.connected is wireless headset tri-state. physical sample/status timestamps are Unix epoch milliseconds; freshness uses monotonic time. No automatic gain restoration or speaker reroute on headset/receiver loss.
